title: Deep Microcompression: Structured Pruning and Bit-packed Quantization for Microcontrollers
summary: DMC replaces runtime interpreter-based inference frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow Lite) on microcontrollers with a compile-time pipeline combining structured pruning, quantization-aware training, and fixed-length bit-packing that emits a dependency-free C library. The cost is a full retraining cycle with quantization-aware training, architecture-specific pruning decisions, and demonstrated results limited to a small CNN (LeNet-5) rather than modern model families. It can fail when target workloads require larger models whose accuracy does not survive aggressive pruning and bit-packed quantization, or when the hand-generated C path must be revalidated for each new chip or model revision.
rationale: The reader's production work targets GPU- or API-hosted models, so bare-metal MCU deployment is outside their infrastructure, making this relevant only if edge deployment on constrained hardware becomes a requirement.
technique: Structured pruning with bit-packed quantization for MCU inference
